description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of test cases for git commands related to sparse checkout functionality. It defines functions to set up test environments and executes various tests to verify behaviors like staging sparse entries, handling warnings, and error conditions within git's sparse checkout feature.

methods.name: setup_sparse_entry
methods.description: Prepares a sparse_entry file and stages it in git, optionally writing specific content.

methods.name: test_sparse_entry_unchanged
methods.description: Verifies that the sparse_entry's blob id has not changed.

methods.name: setup_gitignore
methods.description: Creates a .gitignore file to ignore all except sparse_entry.

methods.name: test_sparse_entry_unstaged
methods.description: Checks that sparse_entry remains unstaged after attempting to add it with certain git commands.

calls: git commit --allow-empty -m 'ensure sparse_entry exists at HEAD'
